title: Prooflane — Trace the price. Keep the evidence.
format: Edited walkthrough assembled from real browser captures; not a continuous screen recording

scenes.title: A price dispute needs its sources
scenes.label: THE PROBLEM
facts: A case another reviewer can reproduce
scenes.narration: An invoice says one price. A contract says another. Which agreement applied, and can a second reviewer reproduce the decision? Prooflane gives accounts payable and procurement teams a review record that connects the price difference to its sources. This edited walkthrough uses fictional data and real browser captures.

scenes.title: Every source row stays accounted for
scenes.label: SOURCE COVERAGE
facts: $250 excluded billed amount is not savings
scenes.narration: The case starts with invoice and contract CSVs. Prooflane matches the supplier, item, and effective date. Seven of eight invoices enter this calculation. One has no active supplied contract and is excluded with a reason. Its billed amount remains visible; exclusion never turns it into estimated savings.

scenes.title: The reviewer chooses the contract
scenes.label: EXPLICIT SOURCE DECISIONS
scenes.narration: Invoice five hundred and four has two overlapping contract versions. The interface shows the consequence of each eligible price: forty dollars or thirty two dollars. The reviewer explicitly selected C two R. That decision remains attached to the frozen baseline, instead of disappearing into a spreadsheet formula.

scenes.title: A real AI result, independently checked
scenes.label: SAVED AI RUN · 9 NOVEMBER 2026
scenes.narration: This is the saved successful AI run from November ninth, not a new model call during this recording. Vultr Serverless Inference generated Python, and a disposable Docker container executed it. An independent Decimal verifier checked every finding. The result is seven hundred and sixty eight dollars of positive price variance, not recovered cash.

scenes.title: The execution has a visible record
scenes.label: SAVED AI RUN · REQUEST IDENTITIES
facts: Verified amounts filled in by the server
scenes.narration: The proof chapter exposes the actual returned model and both Vultr request identifiers. After verification, the model selected the focus of the review guidance. The server inserted the checked amounts. Generated code runs with no network, no host mounts, no injected credentials, and strict resource limits. Docker unavailability causes refusal.

scenes.title: Know when the priority changes
scenes.label: EXACT WHAT-IF ARITHMETIC
facts: One C1 price links three invoices
scenes.narration: Prooflane also calculates when a review priority would change. One shared contract price affects three invoices together. At eighty two dollars and fifty nine cents, invoice five hundred and one remains first. One cent higher produces a tie; the next cent changes the leader. These are explicit arithmetic assumptions, not AI predictions.

scenes.title: Containment is observed on the VM
scenes.label: FRESH BROWSER CHECK · 9 NOVEMBER 2026
facts: Network access and root writes denied
scenes.narration: Here is the containment moment. These fixed probes were freshly run from the public site on the existing Vultr virtual machine. Network access failed, a root filesystem write was denied, the inference credential variable was absent, the effective user was non root, and container removal was confirmed. Five observed checks passed.

scenes.title: The evidence survives the session
scenes.label: FRESH PACKET RECONSTRUCTION
facts: CLI verification works without our server
scenes.narration: A reviewer can download the source linked JSON packet and check it again. The original AI packet passed all seven verification groups in the browser and in the offline command line verifier. These checks reconstruct source choices, arithmetic, hashes, and priority boundaries. They do not authenticate the supplier or prove that a supplied contract is true.

scenes.title: A focused workflow with a clear next test
scenes.label: BUSINESS VALUE AND LIMITS
facts: CSV exports from existing AP workflows
No claimed customers or recovered savings
scenes.narration: The initial audience is accounts payable teams that already export invoice and contract tables. A team subscription for recurring exception reviews is a business hypothesis. We have not measured customer savings or adoption. Our next validation compares how quickly a second reviewer can reproduce the same dispute with a spreadsheet and with a Prooflane packet.

scenes.title: Try Prooflane. Inspect the evidence.
scenes.label: VULTR AGENT RUSH · BLAST RADIUS ZERO
scenes.narration: Try the public demo, inspect the open source repository, and verify the included fictional case yourself. Prooflane connects source decisions, contained AI execution, and portable arithmetic evidence. Our four person team participated online. The prototype is available now on Vultr.
